page.content:
Sheriff's trap in Nottingham that Robin wins in disguise.

How Archery contest connects

  • Artist: Robin of Sherwood — Robin wins the contest in disguise.
  • Location: Nottingham — The sheriff's archery contest is staged in Nottingham.
  • Weapon: Longbow — The contest is a public trial of the longbow.

What is Archery contest?

The archery contest is the set-piece of many tellings: a golden or silver arrow, the sheriff's ambush, and Robin's winning shot before the band must fight free.

Key threads lead to Robin of Sherwood, Nottingham and Longbow.
